  • Exercise - Even if it is just taking a walk everyday when the weather is nice or taking your dog to a dog park or hitting up the eliptical at your house or the gym. Even if it's just pushups, situps and dumb bell workouts while you're watching TV or playing games

Try and make steps in that direction. Maybe it's driving uber one day a week or volunteering somewhere one day a week just to get around some new people and flash some smiles. Start slow and work up from there. The same is true for your fitness. If you are in awful shape then start out with walks or light workouts on the machine. Even if you were in great shape in the past, years ago, it will take some time to get there again. The same is true if you decide to take up hunting or fishing.
